title: Largest Anagram Group
statement:
Two words are anagrams when they use exactly the same letters the same number of times, for example `listen` and `silent`. Put the words into groups so that every group holds words that are anagrams of each other, and report the size of the largest group.

Equal words are separate entries. They are anagrams of each other, so they land in the same group and each one counts.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. Each of the next `n` lines contains one word made of lowercase letters.

## Output
Print the size of the largest group.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 20000`
- `1 <= length of each word <= 15`

samples.input:
6
listen
silent
enlist
google
gogole
abc
